findings.claim: The `.prometheus` scan includes explicitly ignored local-only conversation/cache files, so a pre-commit scan can fail on files that must never be committed.
findings.evidence: `walk(root, files)` recursively adds every file and the loop only skips `scan-allowlist.json` (`if (path.resolve(file) === path.resolve(allowlistFile)) continue;`), while `.prometheus/.gitignore` lines 5-8 explicitly ignore `knowledge/wiki/karpathy-session-*.md`, `knowledge/.prompt-snapshots/`, and `events.jsonl`; the added `agent-tooling/karpathy-logging` requirement says conversation text/absolute-local-path files under `.prometheus/` MUST be excluded from version control and all other `.prometheus/` content must pass the PHI/secret scan.
findings.suggested_fix: Have `scan-prometheus` scan only tracked/staged-or-committable `.prometheus` files, or explicitly skip the local-only ignored paths listed in `.prometheus/.gitignore`.

findings.claim: `.prometheus/.flush-cursor` is marked local-only even though the knowledge-curator persona is instructed to reset it during monthly ledger rotation.
findings.evidence: `.prometheus/.gitignore` ignores `.flush-cursor`, but `.claude/agents/fhir-knowledge-curator.md` says writable paths include `.prometheus/.flush-cursor` during monthly rotation, and the acceptance criterion for 1.2 requires rotation of `agent-ledger.jsonl` and `.flush-cursor`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove `.flush-cursor` from `.prometheus/.gitignore` if rotation state is intended to be committed, or change the curator/spec wording to make it clear the cursor is uncommitted local state.
